items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 will run at only 30 FPS on consoles at launch, no performance mode promised — even the souped-up PS5 Pro might not get 60 FPS support
items.description: GTA 6 is currently running at 30 FPS at Rockstar internally with no confirmation on a 60 FPS mode being available at launch, or even later.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 17 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter It's almost hard to believe that Grand Theft Auto VI is finally almost here after years of waiting. Even more surreal was seeing the first official gameplay reveal happen only three months before launch, which came with an inevitable update: GTA 6 will be locked to 30 FPS. YouTuber Davy Jones was invited by Rockstar North for a three-hour gameplay showcase where leadership confirmed the game does not target 60 FPS at launch. GTA 6, o NOVO TRAILER, Extended Look Oficial - YouTube Watch On Head of Development at Rockstar North, Rob Nelson, played the game for 2+ hours in front of Jones, who then detailed the experience on his Flow Games podcast. He said he could see the game running at 30 FPS during the demonstration, so he inquired about performance modes. Nelson replied that the game runs at 30 FPS for now, and that he'd need to "consult the technical team" for whether we'll see 60 FPS at launch "or later."This has been the standard for Rockstar games for more than a decade at this point — release the game with a 30 FPS target in mind and update it later with a 60 FPS patch on more performant hardware. GTA V runs at 30 FPS on both the PS3 and PS4, but got updated to run at 60 FPS on the PS5. Red Dead Redemption 2 is unfortunately still stuck at 60 FPS on even current-gen consoles, however.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Following that track record, we likely won't see 60 FPS support on consoles till the PS7, while PC will enjoy unlocked frame rates once its port drops down the line. Digital Foundry expounded upon the 30 FPS limitation, theorizing that the high NPC density, dynamic weather, physics simulation, and advanced traffic AI will be too much for a console's CPU to handle. The GPU is not the bottleneck, because otherwise the PS5 Pro wouldn't have an issue pushing 60 FPS.Nelson didn't confirm anything about performance modes either, which gives further credence to the PS5 Pro assumption. Rockstar also remained tight-lipped about what resolution we can expect across the different consoles; Digital Foundry says yesterday's presentation ran at upscaled 4K (from 1440p). The Xbox Series S is considerably slower than the base PS5 and Xbox Series X, while the PS5 Pro packs a lot more grunt, along with PSSR 2 for upscaling. You may like PS5 emulation hits new milestone in record time, multiple 3D games now playable in Kyty Grand Theft Auto 6 preorders begin tonight at midnight local time in the US; here's where to buy Rockstar releases statement after a week of GTA VI leaks, avoids mentioning leaker's demands (Image credit: Rockstar Games)The same goes for other details like ray tracing, though it's widely speculated that GTA VI is relying on ray-traced reflections and lighting, which will likely improve in quality on the PS5 Pro, implying that Rockstar is prioritizing graphics over raw framerates. The gameplay released yesterday was captured on the base PS5. While the visual fidelity was on-point, keen-eyed viewers were able to notice the intense motion blur used in some scenes.The car chase with the police particularly stands out because the fast-moving gameplay had visible smears and subtle streaking across different elements while the interwoven cutscenes did not. It seems like motion blur will be required to make the game feel smoother than it really is; besides, it can't be turned off on consoles anyway. Perhaps a 40 FPS mode could serve as a middle-ground tradeoff for 120 Hz VRR displays.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.
items.author: Hassam Nasir
items.titleZh: Grand Theft Auto 6 will run at only 30 FPS on consoles at launch, no performance mode promised — even the souped-up PS5 Pro might not get 60 FPS support
items.descriptionZh:
《GTA 6》 距离发售仅剩三个月，Rockstar 终于放出了首段官方实机演示，但随之而来的是一则让不少玩家失望的消息：游戏在发售时将锁定 30 帧，不会提供 60 帧模式。这一决定来自 Rockstar North 开发负责人 Rob Nelson 的亲自确认。

知名 YouTuber Davy Jones 受邀前往 Rockstar North 体验了长达三小时的非公开演示。在 Jones 的 Flow Games 播客中，他详细描述了这段经历：Nelson 现场游玩了超过两小时，期间 Jones 注意到游戏明显运行在 30 帧，于是主动询问是否存在性能模式。Nelson 回应称“目前确实是 30 帧”，并提到是否需要“咨询技术团队”才能确定发售时或未来是否支持 60 帧。

这其实延续了 Rockstar 近十年的老传统——先以 30 帧为基准发售，再在更强硬件上推出 60 帧补丁。回顾历史：《GTA 5》在 PS3 和 PS4 上都是 30 帧，直到 PS5 版才解锁 60 帧；而《荒野大镖客 2》即便在当代主机上依然维持在 30 帧（原文此处有误写为 60 帧）。按照这个节奏，主机玩家或许要等到下一代甚至下下代平台（例如传说中的 PS7）才能体验 60 帧的《GTA 6》，而 PC 版从首发起就能解锁帧率上限。

为何 30 帧？知名技术分析媒体 Digital Foundry 给出了深入推测：瓶颈并不在 GPU，而在 CPU。游戏拥有极高的 NPC 密度、动态天气系统、复杂的物理模拟，以及先进的交通 AI，这些系统对 CPU 的负载极大，已超出当代主机 CPU 的实时处理能力。如果瓶颈在 GPU，那么性能更强的 PS5 Pro 本应轻松跑出 60 帧——但 Rockstar 并未确认任何针对 PS5 Pro 的专属性能模式，这恰恰印证了 CPU 受限的判断。

分辨率方面同样成谜。Digital Foundry 表示，昨日公开的演示画面实际以 1440p 渲染，再上采样至 4K 输出。不同主机之间的解析度差异也未公布，但毫无疑问 Xbox Series S 会是性能最弱的一方，而 PS5 Pro 凭借更强的算力及 PSSR 2 超分技术，理论上能提供更好的画质。光线追踪细节同样没有官方说明，不过外界普遍猜测《GTA 6》重度依赖光追反射与全局光照，且这些效果在 PS5 Pro 上会显著增强——这传递出一个明确信号：Rockstar 选择优先保证视觉冲击力，而非追求高帧率。

昨天公开的实机画面基于基础版 PS5 录制，视觉保真度确实出色，但眼尖的观众发现了强烈的动态模糊。尤其是警车追逐场景中，快速移动的画面出现明显拖影和条纹，而穿插其中的过场动画则较为干净。这似乎意味着动态模糊是让游戏“看起来比实际更流畅”的必要手段，而且主机版无法关闭该效果。作为折中方案，未来或许会出现面向 120Hz VRR 显示器优化的 40 帧模式——它在帧率与平滑度之间提供了一个不错的中间值。

总的来说，《GTA 6》的 30 帧锁定向外界传递了几点关键信息：一是 CPU 才是本世代主机开发的主要瓶颈，而非 GPU；二是 Rockstar 依然坚持“画质优先”的旗舰策略，不惜牺牲帧率也要呈现最密集的城市生态与最真实的物理反馈；三是对于追求极限流畅的玩家，PC 版无疑是最终归宿，但前提是等待主机独占期结束。而主机玩家若想体验 60 帧的《GTA 6》，恐怕需要把期望寄托在下一代硬件上。

items.title: Microsoft-backed AI data center faces backlash over alleged unpermitted gas turbines and 1.5M-gallon LNG tank — groups' issues with $19.4B facility range from illegal construction to noise pollution
items.description: The community surrounding the DataOne data center in Vineland, New Jersey, are complaining about the Microsoft-linked project. The company's deployment of several unpermitted gas turbines is just one of the issues that has been hounding the project, with potential water issues also surfacing in recent weeks.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The DataOne data center in Vineland, New Jersey, has faced a slew of complaints from the community since construction began in 2025. According to Stand.earth, the project has reportedly been operating several unpermitted gas turbines on site, spewing air pollution in the area near two local schools. Aside from that, the site has also faced allegations of constructing an unpermitted 1.5-million-gallon liquefied natural gas storage tank and of unacceptable noise levels at night, which affected residents within a half-mile radius of the data center.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleMatt Williams, chairperson of the Sustain South Jersey group, told Tom’s Hardware that construction had already begun even before Nebius signed a multi-year agreement to “deliver dedicated capacity to Microsoft from its new data center in Vineland, New Jersey,” in October 2025. However, the residents only became aware that the project was a data center after the $19.4 billion deal to secure around 100,000 Nvidia GB300 GPUs for the tech giant was made public.Vineland residents began seeing references to the data center in various government documents, prompting several questions to the city government. Because of this, the city called a town hall meeting last January 2026 — several months after construction on the data center had already begun, with DataOne CEO Charles-Antoine Beyney admitting that the meeting should have been initiated several months before.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: the DataOne data center in Vineland, New Jersey (Image credit: Google Maps)A few weeks before the town hall, some people living within a half-mile radius of the site started complaining about noise from the development. While they couldn’t confirm the source of the noise, it was often described as a low hum, similar to that of a generator. A later investigation revealed that the site had 62 gas turbines deployed in the area, with at least 45 running at any given time. This is similar to what SpaceXAI has done in Memphis, Tennessee, where it deployed 69 unpermitted natural gas turbines to power its data centers. While the company has since promised to remove these polluting generators, it will do so only over a span of one year, as they’re being slowly replaced by a 1.2-GW on-site power plant.There have also been concerns that the site’s stormwater management system does not comply with the state’s regulations. A third-party engineering review stated that if these issues are not fixed, they could result in on-site and off-site flooding, especially given the site’s massive 55-acre size. The experts also noted that the data center has “underestimated the annual groundwater recharge by at least 20 million gallons per year,” which could result in lower aquifer levels and reduce the amount of water available or the water quality for the people living in the area. You may like Wisconsin residents file class-action lawsuit against Microsoft's 'world's most powerful AI data center' due to data center noise Elon Musk’s Colossus 2 data center installed 59 natural gas turbines without permission, report claims AI data center developers begin suing local jurisdictions behind bans and moratoriums “The incident should shatter the illusion that Microsoft is a ‘good neighbor’ or in any way more responsible than the other Big Tech companies,” Stand.earth Senior Campaigner Nathan Taft said in the statement. “This investigation has revealed that far from ‘doing this work differently than other’ as it promised, Microsoft is drawing directly from Elon Musk’s xAI playbook of doing the damage first and asking for permission later.” (Image credit: Sustain South Jersey and Stand.earth)In an interview with Tom’s Hardware, Nathan said that even though Microsoft does not directly own or operate the Vineland data center, it stands to reason that the tech giant should do something about all these complaints, as it’s the one that has contracted Nebius for the computing power, which resulted in DataOne’s construction project. He compared this to a contractor making a mess on their client’s neighbor’s property. Even though a third-party provider — DataOne — was at fault for the issue, the fact that the people have already been complaining should give Nebius pause and compel Microsoft to do something.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsDataOne’s actions in New Jersey directly contradict the promise Microsoft made back in January 2026, and residents are asking the tech giant to stand by its word. Although the concerns about air and noise pollution are technically not mentioned in the company’s “community-friendly” commitments, these issues still impact the quality of life of the people living around the DataOne data center. Aside from that, the unpermitted construction shows it does not adhere to the rules of Vineland. “The developers have been ‘act first, pay the fine, and ask for forgiveness later,’” says Mr. Williams. items.titleZh: Microsoft-backed AI data center faces backlash over alleged unpermitted gas turbines and 1.5M-gallon LNG tank — groups' issues with $19.4B facility range from illegal construction to noise pollution
items.descriptionZh:
新泽西州瓦恩兰（Vineland）的DataOne数据中心自2025年动工以来便持续遭到当地社区强烈抗议。环保组织Stand.earth调查发现，该项目在未取得任何许可的情况下，擅自运行数十台燃气轮机，向紧邻两所学校的区域排放空气污染物；同时还违规建造了一座容量达150万加仑的液化天然气储罐，夜间噪音更令半英里范围内的居民不堪其扰。这起事件因背后涉及微软（Microsoft）、英伟达（Nvidia）GB300 GPU以及百亿美元级别的AI算力合同，迅速成为AI基础设施扩张与社区矛盾交织的典型样本。

## 背景：AI算力狂欢下的“先上车后补票”

2025年10月，欧洲云服务商Nebius与微软签署了一份为期多年、价值194亿美元的协议，约定为其位于瓦恩兰的新数据中心提供专属算力容量，以部署约10万块英伟达GB300 GPU。根据Sustain South Jersey组织主席马特·威廉姆斯（Matt Williams）的说法，实际上在该协议公开之前，DataOne的施工就已悄然启动，而当地居民直到这笔巨额交易曝光后，才意识到自家旁边正在兴建的是一个大型AI数据中心。此后，居民在政府文件中频繁看到关于该项目的条目，并由此向市政当局提出质询，最终促使市政府在2026年1月召开了一场市政厅会议——此时距开工建设已过去数月。DataOne首席执行官查尔斯-安托万·贝尼（Charles-Antoine Beyney）在会议中承认，这场沟通会本应提前数月举行。

## 核心问题：62台无证燃气轮机与“发电机式”噪音

在市政厅会议召开前几周，住在工地半英里范围内的居民开始反映夜间出现类似发电机低频嗡鸣的噪音。后续调查揭示，该场地内部署了62台燃气轮机，且任何时刻至少有45台在同时运行。这种为数据中心供电而临时搭设的燃气轮机阵列并非孤例——马斯克的xAI在田纳西州孟菲斯的算力基地同样违规安装了69台天然气轮机，至今才承诺在一年内逐步拆除，并由一座1.2吉瓦的现场电厂替代。此外，DataOne项目选址占地55英亩，其雨水管理系统被第三方工程审查认定为不符合州级法规，可能导致场内及周边区域洪水风险；专家还指出，该中心对年均地下水回补量的估算至少低估了2000万加仑，长期将导致含水层水位下降、影响周边居民的用水量与水质。

## 对比参照：微软的“好邻居”人设与xAI剧本

Stand.earth高级活动家内森·塔夫特（Nathan Taft）在声明中直言：“这起事件应打破微软作为‘好邻居’的幻觉。调查显示，微软远非其所承诺的‘以不同方式做事’，而是直接照搬了埃隆·马斯克xAI‘先造成破坏、再申请许可’的剧本。”塔夫特在接受Tom's Hardware采访时进一步表示，尽管微软并不直接拥有或运营瓦恩兰数据中心，但作为向Nebius订购算力的最终客户，面对DataOne造成的环境与邻里纠纷，理应介入。他以“承包商在客户邻居家的院子里乱扔垃圾”作比——即便过错方是第三方DataOne，但持续的投诉已足以让Nebius和微软重新审视其供应链责任。

这场风波还与其他多起事件形成呼应：威斯康星州居民曾就微软“全球最强AI数据中心”的噪音问题提起集体诉讼；马斯克旗下的Colossus 2数据中心被曝未获许可安装59台天然气轮机；同时也有多家AI数据中心开发商反手起诉出台禁令的地方政府。DataOne在瓦恩兰的所作所为，直接违背了微软在2026年1月公开做出的“社区友好”承诺——尽管严格来说，空气与噪音污染并未被列入该承诺的具体条款，但它们切实影响着周边居民的生活品质，而未获许可的施工更说明项目方并未遵循瓦恩兰市的规则。正如威廉姆斯所言：“开发商们一贯‘先行动、交罚金、再请求原谅’。”

items.titleZh: 推理期间的Rowhammer后门注入攻击（东北大学）
items.descriptionZh:
人工智能模型在推理阶段的安全性正面临一种全新的硬件级威胁。美国东北大学的研究人员发表了一篇题为《ROBBIN：推理期间基于Rowhammer的后门注入攻击》的技术论文，提出了一种将DRAM芯片特异性漏洞与后门构造过程深度融合的攻击方法。

**背景：从软件后门到硬件后门**

传统意义上的神经网络后门攻击通常在训练阶段实施——攻击者通过投毒训练数据或在模型中植入触发器，使模型在遇到特定输入模式时产生预设的错误输出。然而，这类攻击需要控制训练流程或修改模型文件，在现实中面临较大阻力。近年来的研究发现，硬件层面的漏洞同样可以用来实施后门攻击，其中最受关注的便是Rowhammer效应。

Rowhammer是DRAM内存中一种经典的物理可靠性漏洞。当攻击者对内存的某一行（row）进行高频反复访问（即"锤击"）时，由于存储单元之间电容耦合产生的电磁干扰，相邻行的电荷会发生泄漏，导致存储的比特值意外翻转——0变成1或1变成0。这一现象在DRAM工艺微缩至深亚微米节点后愈发严重，已成为内存安全领域公认的硬件缺陷。

**ROBBIN的核心创新：硬件感知的后门构造**

已有的基于Rowhammer的后门注入研究往往假设攻击者可以任意翻转目标比特，但现实情况是：不同DRAM芯片、甚至同一芯片上的不同存储单元，其物理脆弱性存在显著差异。某些比特位置可能极难翻转，而另一些则一触即发。忽视这种差异会导致攻击成功率低下，甚至完全失败。

ROBBIN的关键突破在于将这种设备特定的漏洞特征纳入后门构造的整个过程中。其攻击流程分为两个阶段：首先，攻击者对目标DRAM进行特征刻画（characterization），系统性地扫描并记录哪些存储单元的比特翻转阈值低、翻转行为可预测且稳定；然后，利用这份"漏洞地图"迭代式地选择最佳的DRAM比特位置作为后门注入目标。这意味着ROBBIN不是盲目地尝试翻转任意比特，而是精准地挑选那些物理上最容易被利用的比特，将模型的权重参数映射到这些比特位上，通过翻转它们来植入一个隐蔽的后门触发器。

这种硬件感知的方法论使得攻击在真实设备上的成功率大幅提升，同时也意味着后门构造变成了一个"定制化"过程——每个目标设备都有其独特的攻击指纹。

**技术影响与安全启示**

ROBBIN展示的攻击场景具有极强的隐蔽性：整个攻击发生在推理阶段，无需修改软件代码、无需接触训练数据、也不会在模型文件中留下任何痕迹。受害模型在日常使用中表现完全正常，只有在攻击者叠加特定触发器输入时，才会产生定向的错误分类结果。这使其成为供应链攻击、云服务攻击和边缘设备攻击的潜在利器。

从产业角度看，这项研究对AI芯片设计、边缘计算部署和云安全架构提出了严峻挑战。它表明，仅仅保护软件层面的模型完整性已经远远不够，内存物理层的可靠性同样可能成为攻击入口。未来，高可靠性的ECC（纠错码）内存、Rowhammer缓解机制（如刷新率动态调整、行隔离技术）、以及针对推理工作负载的内存访问模式检测，可能成为AI系统安全部署的必要条件。

该论文发表于半导体行业权威媒体Semiconductor Engineering，反映了硬件安全与AI安全的交叉领域正成为学术界和工业界关注的焦点。

history.description: GTA 6 is currently running at 30 FPS at Rockstar internally with no confirmation on a 60 FPS mode being available at launch, or even later.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 17 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter It's almost hard to believe that Grand Theft Auto VI is finally almost here after years of waiting. Even more surreal was seeing the first official gameplay reveal happen only three months before launch, which came with an inevitable update: GTA 6 will be locked to 30 FPS. YouTuber Davy Jones was invited by Rockstar North for a three-hour gameplay showcase where leadership confirmed the game does not target 60 FPS at launch. GTA 6, o NOVO TRAILER, Extended Look Oficial - YouTube Watch On Head of Development at Rockstar North, Rob Nelson, played the game for 2+ hours in front of Jones, who then detailed the experience on his Flow Games podcast. He said he could see the game running at 30 FPS during the demonstration, so he inquired about performance modes. Nelson replied that the game runs at 30 FPS for now, and that he'd need to "consult the technical team" for whether we'll see 60 FPS at launch "or later."This has been the standard for Rockstar games for more than a decade at this point — release the game with a 30 FPS target in mind and update it later with a 60 FPS patch on more performant hardware. GTA V runs at 30 FPS on both the PS3 and PS4, but got updated to run at 60 FPS on the PS5. Red Dead Redemption 2 is unfortunately still stuck at 60 FPS on even current-gen consoles, however.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Following that track record, we likely won't see 60 FPS support on consoles till the PS7, while PC will enjoy unlocked frame rates once its port drops down the line. Digital Foundry expounded upon the 30 FPS limitation, theorizing that the high NPC density, dynamic weather, physics simulation, and advanced traffic AI will be too much for a console's CPU to handle. The GPU is not the bottleneck, because otherwise the PS5 Pro wouldn't have an issue pushing 60 FPS.Nelson didn't confirm anything about performance modes either, which gives further credence to the PS5 Pro assumption. Rockstar also remained tight-lipped about what resolution we can expect across the different consoles; Digital Foundry says yesterday's presentation ran at upscaled 4K (from 1440p). The Xbox Series S is considerably slower than the base PS5 and Xbox Series X, while the PS5 Pro packs a lot more grunt, along with PSSR 2 for upscaling. You may like PS5 emulation hits new milestone in record time, multiple 3D games now playable in Kyty Grand Theft Auto 6 preorders begin tonight at midnight local time in the US; here's where to buy Rockstar releases statement after a week of GTA VI leaks, avoids mentioning leaker's demands (Image credit: Rockstar Games)The same goes for other details like ray tracing, though it's widely speculated that GTA VI is relying on ray-traced reflections and lighting, which will likely improve in quality on the PS5 Pro, implying that Rockstar is prioritizing graphics over raw framerates. The gameplay released yesterday was captured on the base PS5. While the visual fidelity was on-point, keen-eyed viewers were able to notice the intense motion blur used in some scenes.The car chase with the police particularly stands out because the fast-moving gameplay had visible smears and subtle streaking across different elements while the interwoven cutscenes did not. It seems like motion blur will be required to make the game feel smoother than it really is; besides, it can't be turned off on consoles anyway. Perhaps a 40 FPS mode could serve as a middle-ground tradeoff for 120 Hz VRR displays.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.
history.author: Hassam Nasir
history.titleZh: Grand Theft Auto 6 will run at only 30 FPS on consoles at launch, no performance mode promised — even the souped-up PS5 Pro might not get 60 FPS support
history.descriptionZh:
《GTA 6》 距离发售仅剩三个月，Rockstar 终于放出了首段官方实机演示，但随之而来的是一则让不少玩家失望的消息：游戏在发售时将锁定 30 帧，不会提供 60 帧模式。这一决定来自 Rockstar North 开发负责人 Rob Nelson 的亲自确认。

知名 YouTuber Davy Jones 受邀前往 Rockstar North 体验了长达三小时的非公开演示。在 Jones 的 Flow Games 播客中，他详细描述了这段经历：Nelson 现场游玩了超过两小时，期间 Jones 注意到游戏明显运行在 30 帧，于是主动询问是否存在性能模式。Nelson 回应称“目前确实是 30 帧”，并提到是否需要“咨询技术团队”才能确定发售时或未来是否支持 60 帧。

这其实延续了 Rockstar 近十年的老传统——先以 30 帧为基准发售，再在更强硬件上推出 60 帧补丁。回顾历史：《GTA 5》在 PS3 和 PS4 上都是 30 帧，直到 PS5 版才解锁 60 帧；而《荒野大镖客 2》即便在当代主机上依然维持在 30 帧（原文此处有误写为 60 帧）。按照这个节奏，主机玩家或许要等到下一代甚至下下代平台（例如传说中的 PS7）才能体验 60 帧的《GTA 6》，而 PC 版从首发起就能解锁帧率上限。

为何 30 帧？知名技术分析媒体 Digital Foundry 给出了深入推测：瓶颈并不在 GPU，而在 CPU。游戏拥有极高的 NPC 密度、动态天气系统、复杂的物理模拟，以及先进的交通 AI，这些系统对 CPU 的负载极大，已超出当代主机 CPU 的实时处理能力。如果瓶颈在 GPU，那么性能更强的 PS5 Pro 本应轻松跑出 60 帧——但 Rockstar 并未确认任何针对 PS5 Pro 的专属性能模式，这恰恰印证了 CPU 受限的判断。

分辨率方面同样成谜。Digital Foundry 表示，昨日公开的演示画面实际以 1440p 渲染，再上采样至 4K 输出。不同主机之间的解析度差异也未公布，但毫无疑问 Xbox Series S 会是性能最弱的一方，而 PS5 Pro 凭借更强的算力及 PSSR 2 超分技术，理论上能提供更好的画质。光线追踪细节同样没有官方说明，不过外界普遍猜测《GTA 6》重度依赖光追反射与全局光照，且这些效果在 PS5 Pro 上会显著增强——这传递出一个明确信号：Rockstar 选择优先保证视觉冲击力，而非追求高帧率。

昨天公开的实机画面基于基础版 PS5 录制，视觉保真度确实出色，但眼尖的观众发现了强烈的动态模糊。尤其是警车追逐场景中，快速移动的画面出现明显拖影和条纹，而穿插其中的过场动画则较为干净。这似乎意味着动态模糊是让游戏“看起来比实际更流畅”的必要手段，而且主机版无法关闭该效果。作为折中方案，未来或许会出现面向 120Hz VRR 显示器优化的 40 帧模式——它在帧率与平滑度之间提供了一个不错的中间值。

总的来说，《GTA 6》的 30 帧锁定向外界传递了几点关键信息：一是 CPU 才是本世代主机开发的主要瓶颈，而非 GPU；二是 Rockstar 依然坚持“画质优先”的旗舰策略，不惜牺牲帧率也要呈现最密集的城市生态与最真实的物理反馈；三是对于追求极限流畅的玩家，PC 版无疑是最终归宿，但前提是等待主机独占期结束。而主机玩家若想体验 60 帧的《GTA 6》，恐怕需要把期望寄托在下一代硬件上。

history.title: Microsoft-backed AI data center faces backlash over alleged unpermitted gas turbines and 1.5M-gallon LNG tank — groups' issues with $19.4B facility range from illegal construction to noise pollution
history.description: The community surrounding the DataOne data center in Vineland, New Jersey, are complaining about the Microsoft-linked project. The company's deployment of several unpermitted gas turbines is just one of the issues that has been hounding the project, with potential water issues also surfacing in recent weeks.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The DataOne data center in Vineland, New Jersey, has faced a slew of complaints from the community since construction began in 2025. According to Stand.earth, the project has reportedly been operating several unpermitted gas turbines on site, spewing air pollution in the area near two local schools. Aside from that, the site has also faced allegations of constructing an unpermitted 1.5-million-gallon liquefied natural gas storage tank and of unacceptable noise levels at night, which affected residents within a half-mile radius of the data center.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleMatt Williams, chairperson of the Sustain South Jersey group, told Tom’s Hardware that construction had already begun even before Nebius signed a multi-year agreement to “deliver dedicated capacity to Microsoft from its new data center in Vineland, New Jersey,” in October 2025. However, the residents only became aware that the project was a data center after the $19.4 billion deal to secure around 100,000 Nvidia GB300 GPUs for the tech giant was made public.Vineland residents began seeing references to the data center in various government documents, prompting several questions to the city government. Because of this, the city called a town hall meeting last January 2026 — several months after construction on the data center had already begun, with DataOne CEO Charles-Antoine Beyney admitting that the meeting should have been initiated several months before.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: the DataOne data center in Vineland, New Jersey (Image credit: Google Maps)A few weeks before the town hall, some people living within a half-mile radius of the site started complaining about noise from the development. While they couldn’t confirm the source of the noise, it was often described as a low hum, similar to that of a generator. A later investigation revealed that the site had 62 gas turbines deployed in the area, with at least 45 running at any given time. This is similar to what SpaceXAI has done in Memphis, Tennessee, where it deployed 69 unpermitted natural gas turbines to power its data centers. While the company has since promised to remove these polluting generators, it will do so only over a span of one year, as they’re being slowly replaced by a 1.2-GW on-site power plant.There have also been concerns that the site’s stormwater management system does not comply with the state’s regulations. A third-party engineering review stated that if these issues are not fixed, they could result in on-site and off-site flooding, especially given the site’s massive 55-acre size. The experts also noted that the data center has “underestimated the annual groundwater recharge by at least 20 million gallons per year,” which could result in lower aquifer levels and reduce the amount of water available or the water quality for the people living in the area. You may like Wisconsin residents file class-action lawsuit against Microsoft's 'world's most powerful AI data center' due to data center noise Elon Musk’s Colossus 2 data center installed 59 natural gas turbines without permission, report claims AI data center developers begin suing local jurisdictions behind bans and moratoriums “The incident should shatter the illusion that Microsoft is a ‘good neighbor’ or in any way more responsible than the other Big Tech companies,” Stand.earth Senior Campaigner Nathan Taft said in the statement. “This investigation has revealed that far from ‘doing this work differently than other’ as it promised, Microsoft is drawing directly from Elon Musk’s xAI playbook of doing the damage first and asking for permission later.” (Image credit: Sustain South Jersey and Stand.earth)In an interview with Tom’s Hardware, Nathan said that even though Microsoft does not directly own or operate the Vineland data center, it stands to reason that the tech giant should do something about all these complaints, as it’s the one that has contracted Nebius for the computing power, which resulted in DataOne’s construction project. He compared this to a contractor making a mess on their client’s neighbor’s property. Even though a third-party provider — DataOne — was at fault for the issue, the fact that the people have already been complaining should give Nebius pause and compel Microsoft to do something.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsDataOne’s actions in New Jersey directly contradict the promise Microsoft made back in January 2026, and residents are asking the tech giant to stand by its word. Although the concerns about air and noise pollution are technically not mentioned in the company’s “community-friendly” commitments, these issues still impact the quality of life of the people living around the DataOne data center. Aside from that, the unpermitted construction shows it does not adhere to the rules of Vineland. “The developers have been ‘act first, pay the fine, and ask for forgiveness later,’” says Mr. Williams. history.author: Jowi Morales
history.titleZh: Microsoft-backed AI data center faces backlash over alleged unpermitted gas turbines and 1.5M-gallon LNG tank — groups' issues with $19.4B facility range from illegal construction to noise pollution
history.descriptionZh:
新泽西州瓦恩兰（Vineland）的DataOne数据中心自2025年动工以来便持续遭到当地社区强烈抗议。环保组织Stand.earth调查发现，该项目在未取得任何许可的情况下，擅自运行数十台燃气轮机，向紧邻两所学校的区域排放空气污染物；同时还违规建造了一座容量达150万加仑的液化天然气储罐，夜间噪音更令半英里范围内的居民不堪其扰。这起事件因背后涉及微软（Microsoft）、英伟达（Nvidia）GB300 GPU以及百亿美元级别的AI算力合同，迅速成为AI基础设施扩张与社区矛盾交织的典型样本。

## 背景：AI算力狂欢下的“先上车后补票”

2025年10月，欧洲云服务商Nebius与微软签署了一份为期多年、价值194亿美元的协议，约定为其位于瓦恩兰的新数据中心提供专属算力容量，以部署约10万块英伟达GB300 GPU。根据Sustain South Jersey组织主席马特·威廉姆斯（Matt Williams）的说法，实际上在该协议公开之前，DataOne的施工就已悄然启动，而当地居民直到这笔巨额交易曝光后，才意识到自家旁边正在兴建的是一个大型AI数据中心。此后，居民在政府文件中频繁看到关于该项目的条目，并由此向市政当局提出质询，最终促使市政府在2026年1月召开了一场市政厅会议——此时距开工建设已过去数月。DataOne首席执行官查尔斯-安托万·贝尼（Charles-Antoine Beyney）在会议中承认，这场沟通会本应提前数月举行。

## 核心问题：62台无证燃气轮机与“发电机式”噪音

在市政厅会议召开前几周，住在工地半英里范围内的居民开始反映夜间出现类似发电机低频嗡鸣的噪音。后续调查揭示，该场地内部署了62台燃气轮机，且任何时刻至少有45台在同时运行。这种为数据中心供电而临时搭设的燃气轮机阵列并非孤例——马斯克的xAI在田纳西州孟菲斯的算力基地同样违规安装了69台天然气轮机，至今才承诺在一年内逐步拆除，并由一座1.2吉瓦的现场电厂替代。此外，DataOne项目选址占地55英亩，其雨水管理系统被第三方工程审查认定为不符合州级法规，可能导致场内及周边区域洪水风险；专家还指出，该中心对年均地下水回补量的估算至少低估了2000万加仑，长期将导致含水层水位下降、影响周边居民的用水量与水质。

## 对比参照：微软的“好邻居”人设与xAI剧本

Stand.earth高级活动家内森·塔夫特（Nathan Taft）在声明中直言：“这起事件应打破微软作为‘好邻居’的幻觉。调查显示，微软远非其所承诺的‘以不同方式做事’，而是直接照搬了埃隆·马斯克xAI‘先造成破坏、再申请许可’的剧本。”塔夫特在接受Tom's Hardware采访时进一步表示，尽管微软并不直接拥有或运营瓦恩兰数据中心，但作为向Nebius订购算力的最终客户，面对DataOne造成的环境与邻里纠纷，理应介入。他以“承包商在客户邻居家的院子里乱扔垃圾”作比——即便过错方是第三方DataOne，但持续的投诉已足以让Nebius和微软重新审视其供应链责任。

这场风波还与其他多起事件形成呼应：威斯康星州居民曾就微软“全球最强AI数据中心”的噪音问题提起集体诉讼；马斯克旗下的Colossus 2数据中心被曝未获许可安装59台天然气轮机；同时也有多家AI数据中心开发商反手起诉出台禁令的地方政府。DataOne在瓦恩兰的所作所为，直接违背了微软在2026年1月公开做出的“社区友好”承诺——尽管严格来说，空气与噪音污染并未被列入该承诺的具体条款，但它们切实影响着周边居民的生活品质，而未获许可的施工更说明项目方并未遵循瓦恩兰市的规则。正如威廉姆斯所言：“开发商们一贯‘先行动、交罚金、再请求原谅’。”

history.titleZh: 推理期间的Rowhammer后门注入攻击（东北大学）
history.descriptionZh:
人工智能模型在推理阶段的安全性正面临一种全新的硬件级威胁。美国东北大学的研究人员发表了一篇题为《ROBBIN：推理期间基于Rowhammer的后门注入攻击》的技术论文，提出了一种将DRAM芯片特异性漏洞与后门构造过程深度融合的攻击方法。

**背景：从软件后门到硬件后门**

传统意义上的神经网络后门攻击通常在训练阶段实施——攻击者通过投毒训练数据或在模型中植入触发器，使模型在遇到特定输入模式时产生预设的错误输出。然而，这类攻击需要控制训练流程或修改模型文件，在现实中面临较大阻力。近年来的研究发现，硬件层面的漏洞同样可以用来实施后门攻击，其中最受关注的便是Rowhammer效应。

Rowhammer是DRAM内存中一种经典的物理可靠性漏洞。当攻击者对内存的某一行（row）进行高频反复访问（即"锤击"）时，由于存储单元之间电容耦合产生的电磁干扰，相邻行的电荷会发生泄漏，导致存储的比特值意外翻转——0变成1或1变成0。这一现象在DRAM工艺微缩至深亚微米节点后愈发严重，已成为内存安全领域公认的硬件缺陷。

**ROBBIN的核心创新：硬件感知的后门构造**

已有的基于Rowhammer的后门注入研究往往假设攻击者可以任意翻转目标比特，但现实情况是：不同DRAM芯片、甚至同一芯片上的不同存储单元，其物理脆弱性存在显著差异。某些比特位置可能极难翻转，而另一些则一触即发。忽视这种差异会导致攻击成功率低下，甚至完全失败。

ROBBIN的关键突破在于将这种设备特定的漏洞特征纳入后门构造的整个过程中。其攻击流程分为两个阶段：首先，攻击者对目标DRAM进行特征刻画（characterization），系统性地扫描并记录哪些存储单元的比特翻转阈值低、翻转行为可预测且稳定；然后，利用这份"漏洞地图"迭代式地选择最佳的DRAM比特位置作为后门注入目标。这意味着ROBBIN不是盲目地尝试翻转任意比特，而是精准地挑选那些物理上最容易被利用的比特，将模型的权重参数映射到这些比特位上，通过翻转它们来植入一个隐蔽的后门触发器。

这种硬件感知的方法论使得攻击在真实设备上的成功率大幅提升，同时也意味着后门构造变成了一个"定制化"过程——每个目标设备都有其独特的攻击指纹。

**技术影响与安全启示**

ROBBIN展示的攻击场景具有极强的隐蔽性：整个攻击发生在推理阶段，无需修改软件代码、无需接触训练数据、也不会在模型文件中留下任何痕迹。受害模型在日常使用中表现完全正常，只有在攻击者叠加特定触发器输入时，才会产生定向的错误分类结果。这使其成为供应链攻击、云服务攻击和边缘设备攻击的潜在利器。

从产业角度看，这项研究对AI芯片设计、边缘计算部署和云安全架构提出了严峻挑战。它表明，仅仅保护软件层面的模型完整性已经远远不够，内存物理层的可靠性同样可能成为攻击入口。未来，高可靠性的ECC（纠错码）内存、Rowhammer缓解机制（如刷新率动态调整、行隔离技术）、以及针对推理工作负载的内存访问模式检测，可能成为AI系统安全部署的必要条件。

该论文发表于半导体行业权威媒体Semiconductor Engineering，反映了硬件安全与AI安全的交叉领域正成为学术界和工业界关注的焦点。
